_: Shared copy and structure for the public marketing pages (product-*.html, later pricing.html). Read by scripts/make-marketing-pages.mjs, which writes the committed HTML. The per-page copy lives in marketing-pages.json. Nothing here names the product: the generator stamps {{brand:...}}. A stage's hue class is an EXISTING one from tokens.css (.hue-library, .hue-feature, .hue-plan, .hue-shoot).

writing.blurb: Write in a screenplay editor that sets the format as you type.

story.blurb: Lay your beats out on a board and see the shape of the story.

storyboard.blurb: Turn scenes into frames and plan how each one is covered.

breakdown.blurb: Tag every element in the script, scene by scene.

catalog.blurb: One index of every prop, costume and location the script names.

shot-list.blurb: List the shots for each scene and keep them in order.

schedule.blurb: Arrange scenes into shoot days on a stripboard.

budget.blurb: Estimate costs line by line, from the schedule you already made.

call-sheets.blurb: Build the call sheet for any shoot day from your plan.

cast-crew.blurb: Keep every contact, and who is called on which day.

sides.blurb: Cut the script down to the pages a day needs.
